title: Positive Spin

services.name: Pole Dance Parties
services.desc: BabyCakes has been instructing since January 2023, blending styles with pole, floorwork, twerk, and the occasional chair dance! They love exploring and playing with musicality, contrasting movement with music. Since first approaching pole in late October 2019 and reigniting that passion in the spring of 2022, BabyCakes has come to love and respect this practice for its blend of athleticism and artistry. They approach this practice through a QTBIPOC lens, welcoming movement pathways that challenge traditions and encourage expression. BabyCakes also cares to break the stigma surrounding twerking and pole dancing, spreading awareness on the roots of Black culture and $krippa influence.
